title: Release-proof manifest schema
purpose: Binding contract for what a Verdigris release claim must prove. Evidence is bound as exact values (commit SHAs, exit codes, SHA-256 digests, verbatim command outputs). Missing proof remains missing: CI labels and prose cannot stand in for artifacts.

source_head.note: Routed HEAD at claim time. Implementation commits after 584a7e11 (claim) extend this branch; a validator must re-resolve HEAD and re-verify ancestry of the immutable task base before trusting any binding in this manifest.

commands.name: acceptance.node.manifest-keys
commands.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('orchestration/tasks/TASK-0131-release-proof-manifest/release-proof-manifest.json','utf8'));for(const k of ['schema_version','source_head','commands','environment','artifacts','platform_coverage','rollback','owner_actions','verdict'])if(!(k in j))throw Error('missing '+k);console.log('release proof manifest: PASS')"

commands.name: acceptance.node.negative-cases
commands.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('orchestration/tasks/TASK-0131-release-proof-manifest/fixtures/negative-cases.json','utf8'));for(const k of ['STALE_HEAD','NONZERO_EXIT','MISSING_ARTIFACT','HASH_MISMATCH','UNVERIFIED_ENVIRONMENT','MISSING_ROLLBACK','OWNER_ACTION_UNPROVEN'])if(!j.cases.some(x=>x.expected_error===k))throw Error('missing '+k);console.log('release proof negatives: PASS')"

commands.name: acceptance.rg.release-surface-inventory
commands.stdout_summary: exit 0 on every run. Line counts across runs: 396 (manifest + fixtures + first VALIDATION.md draft), 419 (+ finalized VALIDATION.md), 441 (definitive run with all five task-folder files present); the growth is exclusively this task's own deliverables matching the pattern. Concentration: orchestration task documents (TASK-0120 release-verification-gap-audit REPORT/FINDINGS/SPEC/REVIEW, TASK-0134 distribution-signing-boundary SPEC, PROGRAM_GRAPH, RUN_STATUS, DECISIONS); .github/workflows/ci.yml ('Verify release candidate' step, upload-artifact actions), .github/workflows/native.yml (upload-artifact), .github/CONTRIBUTING.md; one native/build.ps1 comment mentioning an installer directory. Matches are documentation and CI plumbing surfaces, none constitute release evidence.
commands.interpretation: Inventory of existing release-related surfaces. Matches are candidates for future evidence binding, not evidence themselves.

commands.name: acceptance.git.changed-files

The first five entries and the sibling TASK SPECs were routed on this branch before the claim (routed HEAD b3599c80); this worker's writes are confined to orchestration/tasks/TASK-0131-release-proof-manifest/**.
